_comment: Default dry-run config list. Every entry with a `capture` runs entirely against captures/*.pcapng already in the repo -- no hardware, no Ledset, no transmission. This is `python -m tools.oracle.harness run`'s default input. Every `max_tolerated` here is a MEASUREMENT of the named file, not an allowance: the files are fixed on disk, so the exact count is reproducible, and any drift is worth failing on. See docs/ORACLE_HARNESS.md S8.

configs.name: 01-black
configs.notes: 2026-08-06 capture rig, one controller. Baseline: all-zero body. Measured: 46 complete frames, 46 exact matches, 0 tolerated, worst packet recurrence 0/46 = 0%.

configs.name: 02-white
configs.notes: Measured: 46 complete frames, 43 exact, 3 tolerated = 1 torn frame (frame 4, 8 of 16 packets) + a 2-frame loop-boundary blank run (frames 37-38). Worst packet recurrence 1/46 = 2.2%.

configs.name: 03-red
configs.notes: Colour-order check -- a wrong BGR/RGB assumption fails every frame, not just a few. Measured: 44 complete frames, 40 exact, 4 tolerated = a 3-frame loop-boundary blank run (frames 11-13) + 1 torn frame (frame 19). Worst packet recurrence 1/44 = 2.3%, the highest of any real capture.

configs.name: 06-halves
configs.notes: Left half white, right half black. The first spatial check -- a solid colour cannot detect a permutation, this can (coarsely: at port granularity). Measured: 46 complete frames, 41 exact, 5 tolerated = 2 torn frames (6, 7 -- 4 of 16 packets each) + a 3-frame blank run (31-33, which differ in only 8 of 16 packets because the right half is black in the source too). Worst packet recurrence 1/46 = 2.2%. This is the capture an injected port swap fails on: see docs/ORACLE_HARNESS.md S8.

configs.name: 20-ours-white
configs.notes: Our own Python sender's capture, not Ledset's -- the harness validates both a vendor and our own transmission the same way. Measured: 50 complete frames, 50 exact, 0 tolerated, 0 partial frames (our sender stops on a frame boundary; Ledset's captures each end mid-frame). Worst packet recurrence 0/50 = 0%.

configs.name: 8x8_4P_10x5-acceptance-gradient24
configs.notes: The acceptance geometry: three controllers, partial last controller. No capture exists yet -- blocked on the attended Player-page session. See docs/ORACLE_HARNESS.md 'Blocked on the attended session', item 1. Included here (with capture=null) so the report shows this gap as a row, not a silent absence. max_tolerated is DERIVED, not measured -- see the acceptance list for the arithmetic; re-measure it against the real capture the moment one exists.
